title: DOW-UAP-D63, Mission Report, Strait of Hormuz, October 2020
doc_notes: This document is a declassified Mission Report (MISREP) from the U.S. Air Force/USCENTCOM regarding an ISR mission in the Strait of Hormuz in October 2020, containing heavy redactions.

incidents.summary: A U.S. military operator reported observing one UAP during an ISR mission.
